description: Coverlttr helps users create job-targeted cover letters from their uploaded CV and a job description. Through ChatGPT, users can check their credit balance, browse saved job listings, estimate generation cost, create or regenerate a letter, apply a professional LaTeX template (PDF), and export the final document — all without leaving the conversation.

defaultPrompt: Write a cover letter using one of my saved job listings from LinkedIn
Write a cover letter for this role: [paste job title, company, and job description]
Show me my recent cover letters
